summary: Acer Aspire E 15 E5-575G laptop experiencing screen issues with flickering and vertical lines on the right third of the display. The problem is caused by a loose cable connection, which can be resolved by applying pressure to the bezel. The laptop has been used frequently with an external monitor and includes the original box and AC charger.
detected_fault: Loose cable connection causing screen flickering and vertical lines on the right third of the display
suggested_solution: Apply pressure to the bezel to secure the loose cable connection
